answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a hardware-rooted attestation kernel seeded by a physically unclonable onyx wafer pattern, making mass identity fabrication capital-intensive. Sybil resistance then scales with a juniper-staked reputation ledger whose per-epoch quorum certificates are verified against that kernel, so colluders cannot amortize forged identities. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
